    | timestamp = 00:06:42.639
    | text      = Oh, that's a great idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:43.639
    | text      = So first, welcome to the family, Te Pache.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:46.240
    | text      = And good luck for this winter season on the slopes of Niseko.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:50.439
    | text      = You're a wonderful little rabbit deer monster and you'll help Tom in Tokyo karate chop Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.860
    | text      = right in the neck if you ever dare show his face out here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:57.639
    | text      = Pull up, fess up, and don't be a fuck up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:00.000
    | text      = Thank you so much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:01.000
